long_biography.plain_text:
Born into Abu Dhabi's Al Nahyan ruling family, Issa is a son of Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the UAE's founder and first president. He established Pearl Properties, which advanced plans for Al Hekma Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road and The Palisades, a mixed-use district organised around extensive landscaped space.

In 2010 an Emirati court acquitted Issa of charges arising from recorded abuse of an Afghan grain merchant. The judge gave no explanation when announcing the verdict; Issa's lawyer said the court had accepted diminished responsibility after hearing that former associates drugged him. The proceeding prompted international scrutiny of the court process and the UAE's human-rights record.

Born into Abu Dhabi's Al Nahyan ruling family, Issa is a son of Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the UAE's founder and first president. In 2010 an Emirati court acquitted Issa of charges arising from recorded abuse of an Afghan grain merchant. The judge gave no explanation when announcing the verdict; Issa's lawyer said the court had accepted diminished responsibility after hearing that former associates drugged him. The proceeding prompted international scrutiny of the court process and the UAE's human-rights record.

The authoritative record assigns Dhafir to Issa from December 2006. This permits an Al Nahyan family bridge but does not establish the mechanism, timing or legal form of any transfer to Issa.
